description: Vélocité - Points vélos is a dataset listed in Opendata de la Ville de Liège open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Opendata de la Ville de Liège. Le jeu de données reprend les géolocalisations des points vélo permettant la location de vélos "vélocité". Coverage: Liège. The portal files it under Mobilité, Espace public. Its keywords are mobilité douce, mobilité, vélo. The portal shows 1 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-12-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-liege-be-portal.
